title: Google Drops Gemini 4 Argon But You Can't Use It Yet | AI Progress Daily
description:
Google DeepMind has officially unveiled its next-generation frontier intelligence model, Gemini 4 Argon. Plus, we cover the launch of Magnitude, a self-optimizing local agent inference engine, and DoorDash's brand new text-to-order AI agent.
